title: A) Background and prerequisites
text:
The order of the system is found by the difference between the number of poles and the number of zeros (denominator degree minus numerator degree)
Deriving the limits is done using the following:



image.png





image.png





image.png


The bode plot contains also more inforamtion: - the amplitude for \(\omega -> 0\) gives steady state ain in the output for a constant input - Amplitude for \(\omega -> \inf\) denotes the direct feedthrough: it denotes the output gain at a step on the input
In physical systems poles are a system propety while zeors are a result of a specific actuator or sensor placement.
A RHP zero occurs wehn actuator and sensor are on opposing ends of the CoG with sufficient distance
What is wrong with RHP zeros: - Takes a while before system moves in the correct direction - Time domain: response effectively becomes ‘slower’ or delayed - Freq domain: the sstem looses extra phase - limits the achievable bandwidth
